title: Decornaut
blurb: Decorate your real room in mixed reality: stick posters on walls and 3D models on shelves, and they stay put every time you come back. Flip to a floating island to decorate a digital space too.
controls: On the page: Import models (GLB, glTF, OBJ+MTL, FBX, STL, PLY, DAE, 3MF, 3DS, USDZ, WRL, ZIP) or pictures. In the headset: B/Y opens the panel, point + trigger picks and places, stick sizes and turns while holding, grip cancels, trigger a placed thing to move it, hold A/X to delete, left stick walks on the island
